pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark regions with rounded vertices. The edges exhibit smooth pixel gradients, largely attributed to the low resolution and focal blur of the source image. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the lateral flank, becoming smaller and more vertically elongated toward the neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored negative space. Topological junctions are primarily tri-point intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, though definition is reduced by image softness.
